name: Textbook Figure Standard
core_requirements: Rendered-page acceptance remains final authority for student-facing figure closure.
Source asset expectations exist for editable source, SVG/PNG pairing, regeneration, stable filenames, and stale export prevention.
Economic graph conventions exist for axes, units, direct labels, staged figures, color-not-sole-meaning, and text/number concordance.
Student-facing figure defects are blockers, not PASS WITH FLAGS carry items.
Textbook workflow and lead-review instructions cite the figure standard.
No lesson content, generated lesson output, protected machine/external reference data, or product gates are changed.
scope: Add a durable platform-owned textbook figure standard.
Wire the standard into textbook sprint/review expectations.
Record sprint evidence under reports/sprints and references/data/sprints.
Preserve product-gate, paragraph-production, and generated-output boundaries.
forbidden: No edits under references/machine or references/external.
No textbook paragraph, chapter, or book content edits.
No validator that claims to judge subjective visual quality automatically.

No diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery, sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, Scale Gate 1, product-route adoption, or student/product-use authorization.
